sources: Steam Community announcement — DLC 2 updated skills list
mechanics_summary: 200-Stamina Ki Blast Evasive from PQ82 Basic Reward. The user stands in place surrounded by flames; current Xenoverse 2 evidence identifies it as an evasive/counter that can inflict burn/paralysis on an attacker. Official patch notes document a historical change making the opponent able to Z-Vanish more quickly after being hit, which is relevant provenance rather than a timeless current frame rule. Exact active frames, damage, status duration, and post-hit recovery remain unresolved.
evidence_limits: Exact frames, current damage, tracking, status duration, and cancel windows are not promoted without direct evidence.
Historical patch notes and community interaction reports are contextual evidence, not automatically current universal balance values.
